title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1988-09-02
source: Ted Mattes' Master Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100 deck, Sony ESX-HiFi/L750 tape); Schoeps CMC3/MK41 mics, ortf (5th row center, OTS)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard‑style recording captures a solid, decent night with some nice moments but no legendary highs.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clarity and the creative use of rear speakers by Dan Healy, making it a pleasant listening experience. The show itself is described as a beautiful evening of music that was enjoyable yet not standout enough to be called epic, offering good moments without any major flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers found the recording high‑quality and the performance solid; one gave a perfect rating while the other was moderate, leading to an overall strong but not exceptional score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp sound with notable rear‑speaker effects; no reported dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A well‑balanced set that delivered enjoyable moments, though reviewers felt nothing rose to "best show ever" status.
